title: The Mystery of the Dragon Veins
next_chapter_hook: As various powers were vying for the Dragon Veins through covert schemes, a low rumble suddenly echoed from the depths of the capital's forbidden grounds—the sound of an ancient formation that had slumbered for a thousand years being awakened.

text.content: The Imperial Capital, Chengyun Hall. The flickering candlelight cast dancing shadows across rows of memorial tablets. Crown Prince Zhao Chengxuan stood rigid at the hall's center, his face ashen as he glared at the empty coffin. What should have contained the "deceased" Chen Ji was now merely covered in a layer of bone-chilling frost. "Where is he?!" The Crown Prince's voice reverberated through the desolate memorial hall, his suppressed terror barely contained. "This 'remains' that I personally delivered—how could it simply vanish?!"

dialogue.content: Why such rage, Your Highness? A disdainful voice cut through the heavy atmosphere from the hall's entrance. Han Lie strode in with arms crossed, his dark battle armor gleaming coldly in the candlelight. He cast a mocking glance at the vacant coffin, a sarcastic curve forming at the corner of his lips. "The 'remains' of this useless Chen has vanished. In my view, perhaps Your Highness was the one who窃走了 it, using it for some shameful secret?!"

Han Lie! The Crown Prince whirled around, his eyes crimson as he glared at the intruder, his voice trembling slightly from rage. "You reckless fool from the Xuanwu Sect, what right do you have to make such accusations in this place?! I kept that useless Chen's 'remains' here to demonstrate the majesty of our dynasty—now they vanish! Clearly someone deliberately sabotaged this!" His trembling finger pointed accusingly at Han Lie. "Your Xuanwu Sect has always coveted the Tianqing Sect—don't tell me you were the one behind this?!"

text.content: Just as both sides were reaching a breaking point, a sharp voice rang out from outside the hall— "Imperial Envoy has arrived!" The atmosphere in the memorial hall shifted instantly. Both the Crown Prince and Han Lie immediately composed themselves, stepping back. The visitor was an imperial Supervising Censor, an elderly man with white hair and beard, whose gaze cut like a hawk's. He surveyed the memorial hall, his final stare landing on the empty coffin, his brow deeply furrowed. "Chen Ji's 'remains' have disappeared... This matter carries tremendous significance and must be thoroughly investigated."

dialogue.content: May Your Excellency render judgment. An aged yet composed voice resonated from the hall's entrance. Ling Yuan, dressed in a flowing cyan Taoist robe, strode slowly into the memorial hall. With a solemn expression, he gazed upon the vacant coffin, then offered the Crown Prince a subtle bow. "Though Chen Ji was merely a servant of the Tianqing Sect, he was also a 'Guardian of the Nation' bestowed with imperial honor. Now his remains have vanished, and as the Tianqing Sect's leader, I shoulder this responsibility without hesitation." His tone carried genuine grief, though a subtle, hidden malevolence flickered behind his eyes. "I shall spare no effort in cooperating with this investigation, showing no mercy to any villainous scoundrels."

The imperial envoy contemplated silently for a moment before speaking. "Since Sect Leader Ling has volunteered, I shall convey the Emperor's decree on his behalf—this case shall be investigated internally by the Tianqing Sect, with a three-day deadline to uncover the truth. Should you fail to provide answers within three days..." His gaze swept between the Crown Prince, Han Lie, and Ling Yuan, his voice turning sharply cold. "The Imperial Capital's Forbidden Guards will personally intervene, and I doubt any of you will find that outcome pleasant." With that, the envoy swept his sleeve and departed, leaving behind three individuals exchanging uncertain glances.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji stood hidden in the imperial capital's shadows under his new identity, watching Ling Yuan accept the investigation's authority. With all factions' reactions clearly in view, what choice lay before him?

choices.text: Quietly observe, let Ling Yuan reveal his flaws
choices.description: Exploit Ling Yuan's eagerness to prove himself by letting him lead the investigation's direction, observing whether he reveals any weaknesses.
choices.visible_cost: Risk of exposing one's identity during the waiting period
choices.visible_reward: Gather more leverage against Ling Yuan, building strength for a future counterattack
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan investigates too deeply, it may involve more complex forces

text.content: The Imperial Capital's East Market, an unremarkable teahouse on the second floor. Chen Ji changed into a simple gray robe, his appearance slightly modified through basic disguise, appearing to be just an ordinary young wandering cultivator. He sat gracefully by the window, his gaze through the bamboo curtain's gaps perfectly capturing the Crown Prince's mansion entrance. "Interesting..." he gently blew across his teacup's hot steam, a meaningful smile curling his lips. "Old fox Ling Yuan moves rather quickly."

He flipped open the fragment of the Tianji Record in his hands, as Mo Xiansheng's ethereal soul shadow became faintly visible. "Ling Yuan has been entrusted with a crucial mission. On the surface, it appears the imperial court trusts him, but in reality..." Mo Xiansheng's voice remained low and distant. "The Crown Prince and Han Lie are locked in mutual restraint, and neither dares to handle this dangerous task. Only the Tianqing Sect saw an opportunity to seize this advantage." Chen Ji nodded, carefully committing to memory: Ling Yuan desperately wants to achieve merit, so he'll definitely investigate thoroughly. If he uncovers something he shouldn't... that would truly be interesting.

choices.text: Proactively strike, deliver clues to the Crown Prince
choices.description: Anonymously inform the Crown Prince of the connection between Ling Yuan and Chen Ji's death, using the Crown Prince to suppress Ling Yuan.
choices.visible_cost: Risk of exposure when contacting the Crown Prince
choices.visible_reward: Intensify the conflict between the Crown Prince and Ling Yuan, letting Chen Ji profit from their mutual destruction
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan detects someone is manipulating events from the shadows, the investigation may change direction

text.content: Late at night, the Crown Prince's study. Zhao Chengxuan was growing frantic over a table full of documents when a servant hastily entered, presenting an unsigned letter. "Your Highness, it appeared suddenly at the entrance..." Before the servant finished, the Crown Prince had already snatched the letter and unfolded it. The paper contained only a few brief words: "Chen Ji's death holds hidden secrets, Ling Yuan knows the truth. There are deeper mysteries within the Tianqing Sect. If Your Highness wishes to uncover the truth, you may start by investigating the matter of the 'Tianji Record Inheritance' from years ago."

After reading the letter, the Crown Prince's expression shifted between gloom and uncertainty. He held the letter close to the candlelight, watching it turn to ash, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes. "Interesting... whoever is feeding me this information from the shadows knows precisely how to appeal to my interests." He contemplated silently for a moment, then suddenly let out a cold laugh. "Ling Yuan, Ling Yuan, did you think accepting this task would let you claim all the credit? Let's see exactly what you're scheming!" In the shadows, Chen Ji withdrew his gaze and vanished silently into the night.

choices.text: Secretly contact Han Lie, using the enemy to check the enemy
choices.description: Exploit Han Lie's hostility toward the Crown Prince, creating discord between Han Lie and Ling Yuan, letting them consume each other.
choices.visible_cost: Need to personally contact Han Lie, risk of exposure
choices.visible_reward: Xuanwu Sect and Tianqing Sect tensions escalate, balance among the three major sects broken
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie is simple-minded, may not follow arrangements

text.content:
Xuanwu Sect stationed at Imperial City courier station.

Han Lie was alone in the courtyard, repeatedly hammering a piece of dark iron. Each hammer strike raised whistling wind sounds. His trusted attendant rushed over and whispered something in his ear.

"Oh? Someone wants to see me?" Han Lie stopped his movements, brow raised, "Interesting. Let him in. This young lord wants to see who has such audacity."

A cloaked figure was brought before Han Lie. The visitor deliberately lowered his voice, sounding like a middle-aged wandering cultivator:

"Young Master Han, my master sends word—Chen Ji's 'death' is suspicious, yet Ling Yuan proactively took on the investigation rights. There must be something fishy."

He produced a jade slip from his sleeve and presented it with both hands:

"These are some 'small things' my master collected. They may be useful to Young Master Han."

Han Lie took the jade slip, his divine sense probing inside. After a moment, a playful smile appeared on his face:

"Interesting... It seems the water in this imperial city is muddier than this young lord imagined."

Meanwhile, at the Tianqing Sect Council Hall.

Ling Yuan sat in the main seat, an imperial city map spread before him. His finger moved slowly across the map, finally stopping at the position marked with the words "Dragon Vein."

"Chen Ji, Chen Ji..." he murmured to himself, a sinister gleam flickering in his turbid old eyes, "Your 'death' came at such a convenient time. This old man has waited整整 sixty years for this day."

dialogue.content:
Footsteps came from outside the hall. A trusted disciple rushed in and knelt on the ground:

"Reporting to the Sect Master, this disciple has investigated—the servant quarters where Chen Ji lived after his 'death' did have someone enter and exit. However..."

The disciple hesitated, as if reluctant to continue.

Ling Yuan frowned: "Speak!"

"Yes! But that person... this disciple could not trace any clues, as if they appeared out of thin air and vanished the same way. Moreover..." The disciple raised his head, a trace of fear on his face, "The aura that person left behind... is extremely similar to Chen Ji himself."

text.content:
Ling Yuan's fingers suddenly tightened, crushing the tea cup in his hand.

"What did you say?"

His voice was low and terrifying, the temperature in the entire hall seemed to drop several degrees. The disciple quickly kowtowed:

"This disciple dares not speak falsely! That aura... is indeed identical to Chen Ji. However, the cultivation aura is different—Chen Ji should only be at the early Foundation Building stage, a waste. But that person's aura... is unfathomable!"

Ling Yuan fell silent. After a long while, he slowly spoke, his voice seeming to come from the deepest abyss:

"It seems... this game is more complicated than this old man imagined."

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan begins investigating deeply, the situation gradually spirals out of control. What is Chen Ji's next move?

choices.text: Give Ling Yuan some sweet bait, let him find the 'truth'
choices.description: Deliberately leave clues, guide Ling Yuan to investigate a 'truth' carefully designed by Chen Ji, turn the tables on the schemer.
choices.visible_reward: After Ling Yuan finds the false intelligence, he will make wrong judgments and walk into the trap himself
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is cunning and crafty, may see through the trap

text.content:
The next day, Tianqing Sect Outer Court ruins.

This was once where Chen Ji lived as a Servant Disciple, now designated as Forbidden Grounds. Ling Yuan personally led people here, searching every brick and stone inch by inch.

"Sect Master, there's a discovery here!"

A disciple found a dust-covered wooden box under an old bed. Ling Yuan took the box and opened it—a blood-stained jade token lay quietly inside, along with a yellowed letter.

"This is..." Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, unfolding the letter.

On the letter were some scribbled words: "If I die, it must be by someone's scheme. The secret of the Tianji Record... cough cough... hidden in..."

The handwriting stopped abruptly, as if the writer had written these words while extremely weak.

Ling Yuan's pupils suddenly contracted. His gaze死死 stared at those unfinished characters—the "secret of the Tianji Record"!

"Interesting..." Ling Yuan tucked the letter into his sleeve, a cold smile curling at his lips, "Chen Ji, Chen Ji, even in 'death' you're not peaceful. Fine, this old man will grant your wish—let your 'secret'... be revealed to the world."

What he didn't know was that at this moment, a pair of eyes was watching all his movements through some hidden formation.

choices.text: Make no move, continue gathering intelligence from all sides
choices.description: The deeper Ling Yuan investigates, the more he exposes. Better to wait patiently for the right moment, let the opponent make mistakes himself.
choices.visible_cost: Slow progress, may miss a golden opportunity
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more intelligence and leverage on Ling Yuan, the Crown Prince, and Han Lie
choices.risk_hint: If someone touches Chen Nian-related clues during the investigation, there may be unexpected complications

text.content:
Chen Ji sat cross-legged in a hidden underground chamber somewhere in the imperial city, surrounded by complex formation patterns that completely sealed his aura.

He closed his eyes. The Tianji Record Fragment floated before him, its faint silver light illuminating his features intermittently.

"Ling Yuan..." he murmured, "The old score from sixty years ago, I come today to settle it properly."

He reached out and lightly tapped the fragment. A blurry image appeared—it was a fragment of the future he had forcibly glimpsed using his Heavenly Fate Value.

In the image, Ling Yuan stood before a deep underground palace, his eyes flickering with fanatical light. And deep within the palace, a blurry figure bound by chains flickered in and out of visibility...

Chen Ji猛地 opened his eyes, fists clenched tight.

"Deep within the Dragon Vein... Chen Nian..." his voice was low and dangerous, "Looks like we must accelerate."

The three-day deadline arrived in the blink of an eye.

In the imperial court hall, all ministers stood solemnly. The Crown Prince, Han Lie, and Ling Yuan stood in the center, each harboring their own thoughts. The Imperial Emperor sat high on the dragon throne, his expressionless face looking down at those below.

"Sect Master Ling." The Emperor's voice was威严而不怒, "The three-day deadline has arrived. How far have you gotten with the investigation into Chen Ji's 'corpse' disappearance?"

Ling Yuan stepped forward, producing a memorial from his sleeve:

"Reporting to Your Majesty, this old subject has already uncovered the truth—Chen Ji's 'death' was a carefully orchestrated conspiracy! His 'corpse' disappeared because... he never actually died!"

dialogue.content:
At these words, the entire hall erupted in uproar.

The Crown Prince's face changed dramatically, while Han Lie looked at Ling Yuan with an amused expression. Ling Yuan continued:

"This old subject discovered Chen Ji's handwritten letter in his old residence. In the letter, he admits he did not truly die, but faked his death to escape, intending..."

He deliberately paused, his gaze sweeping over the Crown Prince:

"Intending to frame the imperial court and disrupt the balance between the three major sects!"

The Crown Prince erupted in fury: "Ridiculous nonsense! This prince has no grudges with that废物—why would he frame this prince?!"

Ling Yuan laughed coldly: "Does Your Highness truly not know? Chen Ji wrote it clearly in the letter—He says Your Highness tried to recruit him multiple times, and after being refused, harbored resentment. This 'fake death' was precisely to turn the tables!"

text.content:
The Crown Prince and Ling Yuan confronted each other fiercely, the Great Hall filled with palpable tension.

Just then, Han Lie, who had remained silent all along, suddenly spoke up:

"The two of you arguing back and forth, is it interesting?"

His voice wasn't loud, yet it silenced everyone. He cast a sidelong glance at Ling Yuan, a sneer curling his lips:

"Ling Sect Master claims Chen Ji faked his death, yet the evidence is just a letter of dubious origin? In this young master's view, you're crying thief while being the thief yourself. When that waste was alive, you wanted him dead most of all. Now that he's 'dead,' you come out stirring up trouble—tsk, tsk, the waters of the Tianqing Sect run deep indeed."

Ling Yuan's expression darkened, about to retort, when a cold snort came from the dragon throne.

"Enough."

The Emperor's voice was like thunder, silencing everyone present.

"This matter... will be postponed for now." The Emperor's gaze was deep and unfathomable. "I will send the Forbidden Grounds Guardian to investigate personally. Before then, no one is to act rashly."

dialogue.content:
After the court session ended, Chen Ji concealed himself in the shadows, watching as the various factions departed in discord.

He stood atop the highest wine house in the imperial city, overlooking the entire layout of the royal capital. The night wind stirred his robes, and his gaze finally settled on the northwestern corner of the imperial city—that was where the entrance to the imperial Forbidden Grounds lay, as well as the gathering place of the Dragon Veins.

"The Emperor sending the Forbidden Grounds Guardian to intervene..." he murmured to himself, a cold smile curling his lips. "It seems Father's chess game is even grander than I imagined."

He turned and departed, his figure vanishing into the night.

And at that very moment, deep within the imperial Forbidden Grounds, a low rumble shattered the long-standing silence. The ancient formation that had slumbered for a thousand years was awakened by some force at this very moment...
